questions.title: Who can send invites?
questions.body: Owners always can. The question is whether admins and members can too. Members inviting grows teams faster but makes seat costs harder to control.

options.label: Everyone
options.description: Any member can invite; owners can revoke.

questions.title: How long is an invite link valid?
questions.body: After this the link shows an expired page and the inviter can resend.

questions.title: What happens when the invitee already has an account?

options.label: Join after sign-in
options.description: Link goes to sign-in, then straight into the team.

options.label: Confirm first
options.description: Show a 'Join Acme?' screen before joining.

decided.title: Invite by
decided.answer: Email only for v1; links and SSO later

decided.title: Seat limit
decided.answer: Enforced at accept, not at invite

uiQuestions: Where the invite button lives: team header or settings page
Pending invites as a table or as cards
